prompt:
=== BEGIN PROMPT A812_S18A_LakeForestPlus_HALL_HERO_v1 ===

Create one photorealistic interior concept of apartment A-812, S18A Lake Forest Plus, HALL_HERO. The objective is direct fidelity to the supplied original Lake Forest villa materials and furniture character.

INPUT ORDER. Image 1: controls/A812_HALL_HERO.png. Subsequent images: references/LF07.jpg, references/LF03.jpg. Keep this input order. If a named camera control is unresolved, assemble it before generation; never substitute a different camera.

SITE EVIDENCE INPUTS. Also attach 08_allapotfelmeres/fotok_profi_20261025/A812/KZS_3162-1070.jpg. These photographs are authority for existing floor, tile, window finish and panorama only; they do not replace Image 1 or redefine its camera.

ORIGINAL LAKE FOREST IDENTITY. Reproduce the supplied original April 20, 2024 Lake Forest villa A-design, not a loose interpretation of luxury. Match the actual reference surfaces: strongly grained grey-brown wood M01, warm brown/taupe stone appearance with fine pale veins M02, white mineral appearance with grey-gold veins M03, restrained brushed bronze/copper-brown metal M05, and off-white finely flecked woven upholstery M06. Material identifiers are visual reference IDs, not manufacturer codes. Keep their relative colour, grain scale, gloss and edges faithful to the reference photograph. Do not invent a stone brand or silently replace an original material with a cheaper imitation. Exact material composition and procurement remain unverified. This is a concept image, not proof of product identity.

CAMERA. Use the unchanged native HALL_HERO camera and crop of control A812_HALL_HERO.png. This is a Blender-derived room view, not an asserted match to any professional photo. Preserve every projected corner, opening and furniture footprint.

APARTMENT LOCK. A-812 preserves the November 19 R7 layout: the asymmetrical 3000 mm wide U-sofa stays in its approved 350 mm forward position, with nominal 850 mm rear access to the 3220 mm storage niche. Keep the distinct N_K cabinet at its 2850 x 400 mm planned footprint, rounded fixed ends and full local height; apply Lake Forest materials without moving or deleting it. The U kitchen and its actual appliance sequence remain, as does the 1600 x 800 mm dining envelope and its drawn chair positions. Principal room ceilings are nominally 2.70 m, but the documented kitchen return has 2.45 m local clearance and the entry 2.50 m; cabinets must follow these changes. Master 05.3/wardrobe 10.3, bedroom 05.2/wardrobe 10.2 and bedroom 05.1 remain separate. R9 controls are design models, not site measurements.

ROOM DESIGN — ORIGINAL VILLA ENTRANCE. Match LF07's finely speckled greige cabinetry, slim restrained frame lines, long bronze pulls and rounded fixed end where the approved cabinet envelope permits it. The original decorative field is granular and quiet, not ribbed velvet or a white upholstered arc. Use a real full-height storage composition with shoe drawers, coats and concealed upper storage, preserving the apartment's corridor width and door swings. A narrow mirror and any inset seat occupy only the established shallow furniture zone. No new freestanding console obstructs circulation. At the kitchen transition, repeat the original grey-brown timber and white grey-gold-veined counter already used in the adjoining room. Show a small bronze key tray and one original-looking clear or white vessel, with switches and service covers accessible. A concealed cabinet underside or side wash adds warm depth only from an identified route; ceiling fittings stay at actual points. Do not turn the existing entrance door into a concealed villa timber door.

ELECTRICAL POINTS. A812-ML01 at entry; A812-ML11/12/13 in corridor; A812-ML14 at the wardrobe zone. These are plan-based identifiers and candidates, not an on-site electrical sign-off.

ARCHITECTURE AND CONTINUITY. Image 1, the named apartment control, governs the camera, crop, lens perspective, wall and ceiling outlines, openings and furniture placement. The villa images govern materials and furniture detailing only. Never borrow the villa room proportions, dark window frames, forest view, stairs, fireplace or ceiling coves. Retain the apartment's actual existing flooring from its site photograph, including plank direction, knots and tone; a neutral control's generic floor shader is not material evidence. Preserve actual wet-room tile, grey doors, white interior window frames, service lids, switches and heating/cooling ceiling fields. Unassigned walls and ceiling remain existing white; new finishes occur only on the specified furniture and mounted decorative fields. Keep the established furniture footprints and clearances; the expressly requested full-height headboard/panel surface may replace the shallow placeholder backing within the same wall plane and allowed build-up; scale reference detailing to fit those objects without moving an opening or shrinking the room contents. Full-height cabinetry closes to the actual local ceiling with a concealed installation allowance. Maintain the same material maps and object transforms in every view.

LIGHTING AND PHOTOGRAPHY. Render a realistic, carefully exposed architectural photograph with restrained 2700 K evening illumination and readable material texture; where a real window is visible retain its genuine daylight or blue-hour view. Dimmable Philips Hue-compatible warm-white ambience may operate between 2200 and 2700 K. Concealed strips must sit in aluminium profiles with opal diffusers and physical shielding; no visible LED dots or bright lines reflected in the screen or mirror. Use furniture-mounted light details and accessible ventilated drivers at the documented existing supply points only. No new ceiling cove, false ceiling, recessed spotlight, invented socket or drilling into a heating/cooling field. A decorative fixture is conditional on mounting, load and electrical compatibility at its original outlet. Technical and wet-zone approval remain pending. Preserve natural whites and the distinction between brown stone, grey-brown timber and bronze; avoid an orange wash that makes everything beige. Landscape output in the exact control aspect ratio, straight verticals, believable reflections, no people, no lettering, no watermark and no collage.

REJECT IF: the room grows, the camera moves, a window is invented, the WSG floor is recoloured, the original material hierarchy disappears, the sofa turns into a cloud-shaped generic product, the brown headboard becomes a pearl padded wall, or the TV field turns into a generic pale travertine wall. Render only physically visible elements; a reverse view must not pull hidden furniture around a corner. Do not use any earlier S07 furnished image as a material authority. This S18 concept requires subsequent geometry, original-material, electrical and full-budget validation.

=== END PROMPT A812_S18A_LakeForestPlus_HALL_HERO_v1 ===

LATEST OWNER DECISIONS AND ACTUAL INPUT ORDER OVERRIDE: image 1 is the fully furnished matching apartment/view from the existing 17-style room series, and is the EDIT TARGET for EXACT camera, crop, room geometry, doors, windows, existing floor and furniture footprints. Subsequent images are ORIGINAL Lake Forest villa material/detail references ONLY. Replace S07's old material interpretation completely; keep the apartment's complete furnishing level. The old INPUT ORDER above is superseded. This is an ENTRY or HALLWAY, not the living room: ignore any inherited generic living-room design paragraphs. No TV, no sofa, no coffee table. Preserve ALL existing full-height storage footprints, grey doors, passage widths, mirror and useful console. Replace former pearl arcs with the ORIGINAL LF07 finely speckled warm greige framed cabinet fronts, slim brushed bronze handles and original restrained door frame lines. Existing rounded fixed return remains if present. Keep practical upper storage and operable doors; never create storage through a structural wall or across a doorway. Simple matching bronze framed mirror, discreet original-material decorative panel, narrow runner where already present, restrained vessel/key tray and soft furniture-integrated glow; fully finished usable hallway. Preserve all useful cabinetry including hall and wardrobes; fully styled rugs, window treatments, lamps, bedding and restrained accessories. On ALL full-height cabinetry, remove EVERY inherited pearl arc, curve motif, fabric embossed swirl and S07 ornamental overlay; ONLY the original Lake Forest straight timber/ivory/taupe fronts, framed entry panels and explicitly referenced diagonal bronze wardrobe insets are allowed. A living TV backing and console use brown fine-white-veined original stone, B TV backing brushed bronze and console brown original stone. Match these across all views, including partial reverse views. Bright readable neutral ambient light with 2700K diffused furniture accents, no orange wash. Do not add architectural ceiling coves, new openings, room space, villa fireplace or extra power points. Do not add any wardrobe, vitrine, tall cupboard or furniture where image 1 has a blank wall. In bedrooms preserve the EXACT original bed width including single beds; never enlarge or recenter the room. In a narrow wardrobe corridor do not copy any bedroom from the reference. Target image 1 is the final authority for camera and visible objects. Landscape exact target ratio, photorealistic, no collage/text/watermark. Concept not construction validation.
